title: 第16章 震憾全场第17章 紫云门真传弟子
content_zh:
虎力丹实在太出名了，无人不识，当即点燃全场。
“陆荣的实力都在陆沉之上了，还嗑什么虎力丹这分明要下死手，非杀陆沉不可啊。”
“真元境一重有一万斤力，虎力丹提高五成，那就是一万五千斤力了，一拳砸出去，十个陆沉都没了。”
“可怜的陆沉。”
陆家上下，无一不摇头，均为陆沉叹息。
婉儿几乎哭晕当场。
连大长老都闭上了眼睛，不想看到陆沉血肉横飞的一幕。
“哈哈，明年今日，就是你陆沉的死忌！”
四长老幸灾乐祸，脸上尽是畅快之色。
“他早就该死了。”
陆正宁厌恶的说道，动用一枚虎力丹来杀陆沉，真是有点浪费。
此时，陆荣气息暴涨，气势大增，犹如一头凶狠的蛮兽。
“奇怪了，双木城是没有虎力丹出售的，你上哪买的虎力丹”
陆沉冷冷看着陆荣，口中却是下着套，“你的虎力丹，不会是假的吧”
“是真是假，等会你就知道了，但到时你就是一个死人了。”
陆荣哈哈一笑，随后又压低声音，低到只有他和陆沉听得见，“陆沉，老子让你死个明白，当年你与周若雪相遇，是我父亲暗中安排的，为的就是帮城主夺你的千年龙元果。”
“城主见你死而不僵，就赏了我一枚虎力丹，让我好好送你下地狱！”
“你死之后，我会照顾婉儿的，那丫头长得越来越标致了，等我把他玩腻了，再送她下去陪你。”
“哈哈哈，你是不是很生气呢”
从陆荣中口套出这么多内幕，陆沉脸色一沉，眼眸迸发出凌厉杀意。

原来，他被周鹤父女设计，竟然还有陆正宁在当内奸。
周鹤助力陆荣，要对他斩草除根，想得美！
陆荣这个混蛋竟然褒渎婉儿，必须死！
陆沉怒火中烧，灵气因情绪而剧烈波动，一道道气流激起，朝四面八方扩散出去。
“陆沉，去死吧，你可以解脱了。”
陆荣狰狞一笑，忽然挥出一拳，如山岳般砸向陆沉。
“炎阳指！”
一指点出，力贯大山，划出一道匹练，爆响不断。
啪！
一指点在拳上，拳头炸开，骨血横飞。
“啊！”
陆荣惨叫一声，右手已被点爆，废得不能再废。
陆沉却没有因此收手，再点一指。
那一指，力重千均，快如闪电，直接点向陆荣的脑门。
content_en:
Hulidan is so famous that no one knows it, and it immediately ignited the whole audience.
"Lu Rong's strength is even higher than that of Lu Chen. He is still taking Tiger Power Pill. This is obviously going to kill him. He must kill Lu Chen."
"The first level of the True Yuan Realm has a strength of 10,000 kilograms. If the Tiger Power Pill is increased by 50%, it will have a strength of 15,000 kilograms. With one punch, ten Lu Chen will be gone."
"Poor Lu Chen."
Everyone in the Lu family shook their heads, and Lu Chen sighed.
Wan'er almost fainted from tears on the spot.
Even the Great Elder closed his eyes, not wanting to see Lu Chen's blood and flesh flying everywhere.
"Haha, next year today will be your death sentence, Lu Chen!"
The fourth elder was gloating over his misfortune, his face full of joy.
"He should have died a long time ago."
Lu Zhengning said in disgust, using a tiger power pill to kill Lu Chen was really a waste.
At this time, Lu Rong's aura surged and his momentum increased greatly, like a ferocious beast.
"It's strange. There is no Huli Pill for sale in Shuangmu City. Where did you buy Huli Pill?"
Lu Chen looked at Lu Rong coldly, but said in a trap, "Your Tiger Power Pill can't be fake, right?"
"You will know later whether it is true or false, but by then you will be a dead person."
Lu Rong laughed, then lowered his voice so low that only he and Lu Chen could hear, "Lu Chen, I want you to understand clearly that my father secretly arranged your encounter with Zhou Ruoxue in order to help the city lord seize your Thousand-Year Dragon Essence Fruit."
"The city lord saw that you were dead and not stiff, so he rewarded me with a tiger power pill and asked me to send you to hell!"
"After you die, I will take care of Wan'er. That girl is getting more and more beautiful. When I get tired of playing with her, I will send her down to stay with you."
"Hahaha, are you very angry?"
After hearing so many inside stories from Lu Rong, Lu Chen's face darkened, and his eyes burst out with fierce murderous intent.
It turned out that he was set up by Zhou He and his daughter, and Lu Zhengning was actually the traitor.
Zhou He helps Lu Rong and wants to eradicate him. What a beautiful idea!
This bastard Lu Rong actually praised Wan'er and must die!
Lu Chen was furious, and his spiritual energy fluctuated violently due to his emotions. A stream of air was stirred up and spread out in all directions.
"Lu Chen, go to hell, you can be freed."
Lu Rong smiled ferociously, and suddenly swung a punch, hitting Lu Chen like a mountain.
"Fire Yang Finger!"
With one finger pointing, the force penetrated the mountain, drawing a line of practice, and the explosion continued.
Snap!
A finger was pointed at the fist, and the fist exploded, with bones and blood flying everywhere.
"Ah!"
Lu Rong screamed, his right hand had been exploded and it was so crippled that it could no longer be crippled.
Lu Chen didn't stop because of this, and clicked his finger again.
That finger, with even force and as fast as lightning, pointed directly at Lu Rong's forehead.
